items.headline: Canada jobs stunner: +60.4K in September vs ~5K expected - BoC Oct cut odds repriced
bullets: Numbers: +60,400 jobs (consensus ~5,000); unemployment rate steady at 7.1% (vs 7.2% expected); all gains full-time (+106K), part-time -46K; wages +3.3% y/y; participation 65.2%.

Meaning: 12x consensus after 100K+ summer losses - manufacturing posted its first gain since January (+28K) despite tariff pressure. But slack remains: jobless rate still up half a point YTD, highest since 2016 ex-pandemic.
FX read-through: USD/CAD dropped ~0.3% to ~1.3985 as markets trimmed BoC cut bets - Oct 29 cut odds fell toward 50-50 from ~70%. CAD was the day's strongest G10 mover.
Next: Canada CPI Tue Oct 21 is the final input before the BoC decision.
